definition: to greet or acclaim enthusiastically; small balls of ice that fall from the sky
example: The crowd hailed the hero with cheers. / Hail damaged the crops last night.

definition: to stop or cause to stop; a stop or pause
example: The train halted at the station. / The project came to a halt.

definition: to hinder or impede the movement or progress of something
example: Heavy rain hampered the rescue efforts.

definition: a disadvantage that makes achievement difficult; to place at a disadvantage
example: His lack of experience was a handicap. / The rules handicapped the team.

definition: useful or convenient; skillful with hands
example: A pocketknife is a handy tool. / She is very handy around the house.

definition: to disturb or bother persistently; to trouble by repeated attacks
example: He claimed that his boss harassed him at work.

definition: a sheltered place for ships; to give shelter or refuge
example: The ship stayed in the harbor. / She harbored a secret.

definition: severe suffering or deprivation
example: They suffered many hardships during the war.

definition: forming a pleasing or consistent whole; free from disagreement
example: They have a harmonious relationship.

definition: unpleasantly rough or severe
example: The harsh winter made travel difficult.

definition: to move or act quickly; to accelerate
example: She hastened to finish her homework.

definition: to pull or drag with effort; the amount taken or won at one time
example: They hauled the boat out of the water. / The police seized a large haul of drugs.

definition: to appear in or inhabit as a ghost; a place frequently visited
example: The old house is said to be haunted. / This café is my favorite haunt.

definition: a danger or risk; to venture or risk something
example: Wet floors are a hazard. / He hazarded a guess.

definition: dangerous or risky
example: Handling chemicals can be hazardous.

definition: full of activity, or very busy and fast
example: She has a hectic schedule.

definition: to pay attention to; careful attention
example: He failed to heed the warning. / Take heed of her advice.

definition: passed from parent to child through genes
example: Eye color is a hereditary trait.

definition: to pause before saying or doing something, usually through uncertainty
example: He hesitated before answering the question.

definition: a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance
example: He rose quickly through the corporate hierarchy.

definition: to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed
example: Bad weather hindered our progress.

definition: to raise or lift something, often with a rope or machine
example: They hoisted the flag at sunrise.

definition: having a hole or empty space inside; a hole or depression in something
example: The tree trunk was hollow. / They found a hollow in the ground.

definition: unfriendly; antagonistic
example: The two countries have a hostile relationship.

definition: to remain in one place in the air
example: A helicopter hovered over the building.

definition: having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance
example: He is very humble despite his success.

definition: having a large amount of water or moisture in the air
example: The weather is hot and humid today.

definition: to make someone feel ashamed or foolish
example: He was humiliated in front of his classmates.

definition: to throw something with force
example: He hurled a rock at the window.

definition: conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease
example: Good hygiene is essential for health.

definition: a proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence
example: The experiment will test the scientist's hypothesis.

definition: a colorless, odorless, highly flammable gas, the chemical element of atomic number 1
example: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
